title: Restore a 1978 Road Bike
description: Dad's old Peugeot PX10, rescued from his garage. The aim is to ride it on the Dales sportive next June, not to build a museum piece. Original parts where they're cheap and safe; modern where it matters (brakes, tyres).

goals.title: Ride the 100km Dales sportive on it next June
goals.description: Needs to be comfortable and reliable for five hours.

goals.title: Keep the bike's original look where it's cheap and safe
goals.description: Decals, lugs and the Simplex derailleur stay.
